Post-training further applies Context-RL and Video-RL with bucket advantage scaling to stabilize long-sequence decision trees and reduce visual hallucinations. Infrastructure includes scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels.
summary_en.experiments: Top-tier results on TimeLens benchmarks (ActivityNet, QVHighlights, Charades) for fine-grained temporal localization, substantially outperforming Gemini-3-Flash on several temporal grounding settings. Non-linear capability scale-up on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench, demonstrating robustness for extensive temporal information. Simultaneously achieves large gains on native agent capabilities (Code, Tool Use, Web Search) while preserving general-purpose reasoning baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction for the motivation on why standard attention fails in long video and how MOPD addresses catastrophic forgetting. The Architecture section on GQA-compatible DSA design (global MQA indexing + grouped GQA aggregation) is the core innovation. Pay close attention to the MOPD dynamic routing mechanism and bucket advantage scaling in Context-RL / Video-RL under the Training and Post-training sections. Study Figure 1 for the overall performance landscape. Estimated 30-45 min for a deep technical read.
summary_en.authors_note: Kuaishou Keye-VL team (Kwai). Iterative work following Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5.

recommendation.zh: DSA 稀疏注意力适配到 GQA 多模态 + 256K 长视频 + MOPD 对齐这一组合值得立刻跟进，重点看 DSA kernel 与多教师 on-policy 蒸馏如何缓解遗忘。
recommendation.en: The combination of DSA sparse attention on GQA multimodal, 256K long-video support, and MOPD alignment is worth immediate follow-up—focus on the DSA kernel details and how multi-teacher on-policy distillation mitigates forgetting.

paper.title: When No Answer Is Correct: Diagnosing Absent Answer Detection for MLLMs in Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made substantial advancements in video understanding, yet the reliability of their responses remains underexplored. This work presents a diagnostic study of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding, where the correct answer is deliberately excluded from the candidate set and a reliable model is expected to recognize that no valid option exists. We evaluate the absent answer detection behavior under three settings: multiple-choice ques

summary.core_problem: MLLM在视频理解中对缺失正确答案的识别能力尚未被系统诊断。
summary.importance: 首次系统诊断MLLM在视频理解中的缺失答案检测行为，含三种评测设置。
summary.technical_approach: 三种设置：多选加NOTA选项、开放式生成加检测指令、无引导标准评测；探索CoT作为缓解策略。
summary.experiments: MLLM压倒性选择看似合理的干扰项而非检测缺失答案；时间推理任务失败更明显；稠密帧采样恶化问题。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLM ability to detect when no correct answer exists in video understanding is undiagnosed.
summary_en.importance: First systematic diagnostic of absent answer detection for MLLMs in video understanding across three evaluation settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three settings: multiple-choice with NOTA, open-ended generation with detection instruction, standard evaluation without guidance; explore CoT as mitigation.
summary_en.experiments: MLLMs overwhelmingly select plausible distractors; failure worse in temporal reasoning; denser frame sampling worsens problem.

recommendation.zh: 对MLLM视频理解可靠性的诊断性研究，发现稠密帧采样反而恶化缺失答案检测，作为领域内备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Diagnostic study of MLLM reliability in video QA; denser frame sampling worsens absent-answer detection. Literature reference only, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Learning Geometric Representations from Videos for Spatial Intelligent Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at 2D semantic understanding but lack intrinsic 3D awareness, resulting in representations that fail to maintain geometric and spatial consistency across video frames. Given the scarcity of large-scale 3D data, we present GeoVR, a novel framework that learns geometric representations using purely 2D video sequences. This approach effectively restructures the semantic latent space within MLLMs to unlock spatial intelligence. Rather than employing sup

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型（MLLM）擅长2D语义理解但缺乏内在3D几何感知，导致跨视频帧的表示不保持几何和空间一致性。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出仅用2D视频学习几何表示的框架 GeoVR，对多模态预训练有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过从预训练3D基础模型蒸馏几何知识重构 MLLM 内部语义潜空间；四目标学习：帧间相机位姿估计、稠密深度图回归、公制尺度因子预测、多尺度特征蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模和对比 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: MLLMs excel at 2D semantic understanding but lack intrinsic 3D awareness, causing representations to fail geometric and spatial consistency across video frames.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: GeoVR framework learning geometric representations from 2D videos alone, with some relevance to multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Reshapes MLLM internal semantic latent space by distilling geometry knowledge from pre-trained 3D foundation models via four objectives: inter-frame camera pose estimation, dense depth map regression, metric scale factor prediction, and multi-scale feature distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes and baseline comparison details not disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 多模态方向的增量工作，用蒸馏让 MLLM 获得3D感知；仅作为跨模态表示学习文献备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Incremental multimodal work using distillation to imbue MLLMs with 3D awareness; literature reference only, do not read the paper.

paper.title: M^3Eval: Multi-Modal Memory Evaluation through Cognitively-Grounded Video Tasks
paper.abstract: As multi-modal models advance towards long-form video understanding, memory emerges as a critical capability. Despite substantial efforts in developing video datasets and benchmarks, existing works primarily focus on perception and reasoning, without systematically evaluating memory: what models retain, how faithfully information is preserved, and how robust memory remains under interference. To address this gap, we introduce M^3Eval, the first comprehensive evaluation framework and benchmark fo

summary.core_problem: 解决现有长视频多模态评测更偏感知与推理、却缺少对“模型记住了什么、记得是否忠实、在干扰下是否稳健”的系统性记忆评估。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测框架与 benchmark。它把多模态记忆拆成更接近认知心理学的维度，适合做长视频 VLM、外部记忆模块或上下文压缩的人用来查缺补漏，但对纯 LLM 预训练方法的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 M^3Eval，用认知心理学启发的任务设计去隔离不同记忆维度，重点考察信息保留、忠实性和抗干扰能力。作者在代表性多模态模型上做广泛实验，分析并行视频流下的表征纠缠、干扰模式以及与人类记忆不同的行为特征。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出数据规模、模型列表和具体分数，但给出几个核心发现：模型在并行视频流下难以保持 disentangled representations，干扰模式与人类显著不同。由于这是评测工作，最值得看的是任务构造是否真正隔离 memory 而非 reasoning，以及干扰实验是否控制了输入长度和信息密度。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of memory in long-form multimodal models: what they retain, how faithfully they retain it, and how robust that memory is under interference.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an evaluation framework and benchmark. It decomposes multimodal memory into cognitively grounded dimensions, which is useful for long-video VLMs, external memory modules, or context-compression work, but its direct impact on core LLM pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces M^3Eval, a cognitively grounded benchmark that isolates different memory dimensions, focusing on retention, fidelity, and robustness to interference. It evaluates representative multimodal models and analyzes behaviors such as representation entanglement under parallel video streams and interference patterns that differ from human memory.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, model list, or exact scores, but it highlights two findings: models struggle to maintain disentangled representations across parallel video streams, and their interference patterns differ substantially from humans. As an evaluation paper, the key thing to inspect is whether the tasks isolate memory rather than generic reasoning, and whether interference is controlled for input length and information density.

recommendation.zh: 更像长视频 VLM 的诊断工具，不必细读；若你做上下文压缩或外部记忆，只看并行流干扰实验，别把它直接外推到文本 LLM。
recommendation.en: This is more of a diagnostic tool for long-video VLMs than a core methods paper; if you work on context compression or memory modules, only read the interference experiments and do not over-generalize to text LLMs.

paper.title: SVI-Bench: A Dynamic Microworld for Strategic Video Intelligence
paper.abstract: True video intelligence demands more than recognizing what is visible: it requires reasoning about why events unfold, predicting what would change under different conditions, and deciding what to do next. We refer to this progression, from perception through causal reasoning and simulation to strategic planning, as Strategic Video Intelligence (SVI). No existing benchmark evaluates this capability stack: in-the-wild videos lack verifiable ground truth for causal and strategic questions, while sy

summary.core_problem: 评测“战略视频智能”：从感知到因果推理/反事实模拟再到策略规划，现有视频benchmark缺少可验证的因果与决策问题。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是benchmark资产与评测协议；对多模态/视频-语言模型的训练与对齐有间接价值（可作为mid-train或post-train的目标分布），但对纯文本LLM预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SVI-Bench：以团队体育为“动态微世界”，利用明确规则与确定结果提供可验证ground truth，同时保留真实多智能体对抗与协作复杂度；包含广播视频、动作标注与（摘要截断）实验/反事实相关数据。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：约35K小时视频、15M动作标注、15K小时（摘要截断）；论文应包含多种VLM/视频模型基线与分层任务评测，但摘要未给出具体模型与分数。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating “Strategic Video Intelligence”: perception → causal/what-if reasoning → simulation → strategic planning, which existing video benchmarks cannot verify reliably.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a benchmark contribution; indirectly useful for training/alignment of video-language models (as a target distribution for mid-/post-training), but limited direct impact on text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVI-Bench uses team sports as a dynamic microworld: real multi-agent adversarial interactions with explicit rules and definitive outcomes to enable verifiable causal and strategic questions; includes broadcast videos, action annotations, and (truncated) experimental/counterfactual components.
summary_en.experiments: Scale: ~35K hours of video, 15M annotated actions, and 15K hours (truncated). The abstract does not list baseline models or scores, but the paper likely reports multi-level tasks and VLM/video-model baselines.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在做视频-语言mid-train/对齐，值得把任务分层与标注可验证性看清；否则当作“体育微世界评测”备查即可。
recommendation.en: Worth checking for video-language mid-train/alignment due to its verifiable, layered tasks; otherwise keep it as a sports-microworld eval reference.

paper.title: From Pixels to Words -- Towards Native One-Vision Models at Scale
paper.abstract: Current vision-language models (VLMs) typically stitch together separate image encoders and language decoders via multi-stage alignment, a modular framework that inevitably fragments pixel-level signals across frames and scatters early pixel-word interactions. In parallel, native VLMs, despite impressive performance on single images, remain largely unexplored in multi-image, video understanding, and spatial intelligence. Hence, we introduce NEO-ov, a native foundation model that learns cross-fra

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文尝试解决 VLM 架构中的模块化割裂问题。常见 VLM 依赖预训练视觉编码器、projector 和 LLM 的多阶段拼接，这会推迟像素和文字的早期交互，也让单图、多图、视频和空间定位能力分别依赖不同组件。NEO-ov 的目标是做一个 encoder-free 的 native one-vision model，用同一个骨干直接处理图像、视频帧、区域和文本。
summary.importance: 它更接近 VLM 预训练范式论文，而不是普通视觉任务论文。对基座研究的价值在于两个问题：第一，视觉是否一定需要外部 encoder 才能进入语言模型；第二，单一自回归骨干能否同时学习空间结构、跨帧关系和文本对齐。若实验规模和消融充分，这类工作会影响多模态预训练中的 tokenizer、序列化、位置编码和视觉-语言早期融合设计。
summary.technical_approach: NEO-ov 取消外部视觉编码器、辅助 adapter 和后处理 fusion。图像先经过一个轻量 embedding 层：两层卷积加 GELU，第一层 stride 16 提取 patch，第二层 stride 2 做局部聚合，最终约每个 32×32 图像区域生成一个 visual token。visual token 用 和 包裹后，与文本 token 拼接成统一序列，并由同一个 backbone 处理。位置建模上，方法采用 Native-RoPE，把 temporal/sequential index 与 spatial h、w index 分开；文本 token 只有 temporal index，图像 token 在同一图像内共享 temporal index，同时保留二维坐标。注意力上使用 THW-decoupled design：保留原 LLM head dimension 作为 temporal 分支，同时引入额外的 H/W head dimensions 来承载空间建模。T 分支负责文本顺序、跨图和跨帧依赖，H/W 分支负责二维空间结构。模型初始化上，Pre-Buffer 和 Post-LLM 层来自 NEO 与 Qwen3，训练目标仍是统一自回归建模。
summary.experiments: 所给内容没有包含完整实验表和具体数值。正文片段声称 NEO-ov 在多类 benchmark 上超过已有 native VLM，并接近使用相同 LLM 的 encoder-based VLM；同时在低层几何感知、高层时空推理和长程视觉依赖上表现较强。可确认的实验结论是：论文重点比较 native encoder-free 路线与传统 encoder-based 路线，并强调单图、多图、视频理解和空间智能的统一评估。具体参数量、训练数据规模、benchmark 分项提升和消融数字需要查看完整实验章节后才能确认。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 30–40 分钟。优先看模型结构部分，尤其是视觉 token 生成、统一序列化、Native-RoPE 和 THW-decoupled attention。实验部分建议直接看三类内容：与 encoder-based VLM 的同 LLM 对比；与已有 native VLM 的对比；去掉 spatial RoPE、THW decoupling、不同视觉 token 粒度后的消融。若只关心预训练范式，可以少看具体下游榜单，多看序列长度、分辨率、视频帧数和训练稳定性相关分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the modularity of current vision-language models. Most systems combine a pretrained vision encoder, a projector, and a language model through staged alignment. This delays early pixel-word interaction and makes single-image, multi-image, video, and spatial understanding depend on separate design choices. NEO-ov aims to build an encoder-free native one-vision model that processes pixels and words inside one backbone.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to multimodal pretraining rather than to a narrow vision application. The main research question is whether a unified autoregressive backbone can learn visual perception, spatial structure, temporal dynamics, and language alignment without a separate visual encoder. For foundation-model work, the useful parts are the visual tokenization choice, serialization scheme, positional encoding, and attention decomposition for native multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: NEO-ov removes the external visual encoder, adapter, and post-hoc fusion module. Images are converted into visual tokens by a lightweight embedding module with two convolution layers and GELU: the first convolution extracts patches with stride 16, and the second aggregates local features with stride 2, producing roughly one token per 32×32 image region. The visual tokens are wrapped by and , concatenated with text tokens, and processed by a single backbone. The model uses Native-RoPE with separate temporal and spatial indices: text tokens carry only a temporal index, while image tokens share a temporal index within an image and keep their h/w coordinates. Attention uses a THW-decoupled design, preserving the original LLM head dimension for the temporal branch while adding H and W dimensions for spatial modeling. The T branch handles text order, cross-image relations, and cross-frame dependencies; the H/W branches encode two-dimensional structure. The Pre-Buffer and Post-LLM layers are initialized from NEO and Qwen3, and the whole system is trained as a unified autoregressive model.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content does not include the full experimental tables or exact numerical results. The visible sections state that NEO-ov outperforms prior native VLMs and approaches encoder-based models using the same LLM across diverse benchmarks. The claimed strengths include low-level geometric perception, high-level spatiotemporal reasoning, and long-range visual dependency modeling. The key comparison is between the native encoder-free design and conventional encoder-based VLMs, across single-image, multi-image, video, and spatial-intelligence evaluations. Exact model sizes, data scale, per-benchmark gains, and ablation numbers require the complete experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Plan for a 30–40 minute skim. Focus first on the architecture: visual token construction, unified serialization, Native-RoPE, and THW-decoupled attention. In the experiments, look for three comparisons: against encoder-based VLMs with the same LLM, against previous native VLMs, and ablations on spatial RoPE, THW attention decomposition, and visual token granularity. If the goal is pretraining insight, spend less time on leaderboard details and more time on sequence length, resolution, frame count, and stability-related analysis.

recommendation.zh: 读架构和训练 recipe，别只看榜单；native VLM 能否规模化，关键在视觉 token 预算和早期对齐是否真的划算。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and training recipe, not just the scores; the real question is whether the visual token budget and early alignment costs pay off at scale.

paper.title: VidPrism: Heterogeneous Mixture of Experts for Image-to-Video Transfer
paper.abstract: With the rapid development of pre-training technologies, adapting large-scale Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for video understanding \emph{\ie} image-to-video transfer learning has become a dominant paradigm. To achieve superior performance, it raises as an effective strategy among recent advances to employ Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) to enhance VLMs' temporal modeling capabilities. However, conventional MoE designs suffer from expert homogenization, where all experts act as identical generalists, i

summary.core_problem: 图像 VLM 迁移到视频理解时，普通 temporal MoE 容易出现专家同质化，不能有效分工建模空间语义和时间动态。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视频 VLM 迁移中的 MoE 结构改进。它不是 LLM 基座训练论文，但对多模态 MoE 的专家分工、路由输入设计和视频时间建模有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VidPrism 提出 heterogeneous temporal MoE，为不同专家指定不同功能角色，覆盖空间理解到时间建模。它还引入 content-aware multi-rate sampling，根据内容动态产生不同帧率或时间粒度的视频流，把合适的信息送入对应专家，减少所有专家学习相同视频统计的倾向。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法用于 image-to-video transfer learning，并与常规 MoE 设计比较，目标是提升视频理解性能。具体使用的 VLM backbone、专家数量、视频数据集、baseline 和提升幅度未在摘要中给出，需要查正文。

summary_en.core_problem: When image VLMs are transferred to video understanding, standard temporal MoE modules can collapse into homogeneous experts that fail to separate spatial semantics from temporal dynamics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an MoE design for video VLM transfer. It is not an LLM pretraining result, but it offers a useful reference point for expert specialization, routing inputs, and temporal modeling in multimodal MoE systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: VidPrism proposes a heterogeneous temporal MoE where experts are assigned different functional roles, ranging from spatial understanding to temporal modeling. A content-aware multi-rate sampling module dynamically creates video streams at different temporal granularities and feeds them to the appropriate specialists.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for image-to-video transfer learning and compares it against conventional MoE designs for video understanding. Backbone details, expert counts, datasets, baselines, and exact gains are not available in the abstract and require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 作为多模态 MoE 备查即可；若正文没有路由熵和专家功能可视化，异构专家很可能只是工程命名。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a multimodal-MoE reference; without routing entropy and expert-role evidence, the heterogeneous experts may just be engineering labels.

paper.title: O-MARC: Omni Memory-Augmented Compression Distillation for Efficient Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Omnimodal large language models enable unified audio video understanding, but long joint token sequences make inference costly, and existing benchmarks do not fully isolate audio visual association in noisy user generated videos. We introduce UGC-AVQA, a public UGC benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, where an audio removal test ensures that benchmark questions require both acoustic and visual evidence. To reduce inference cost, we propose OMAC, a training free plug in compression met

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是全模态视频理解里的压缩问题：音频和视频同时输入时 token 序列很长，直接推理成本高；但简单压缩又容易删掉跨模态证据，尤其是短暂声音、场景切换、动作与声音之间的对应关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在文本基座训练，而在多模态 LM 的输入表示压缩和训练接口。它提醒一个关键点：音频和视频不能简单按各自冗余度独立压缩，因为很多有效信息来自二者的时间对齐和互相解释。对做 native multimodal pretrain、视频/音频 token budget 分配、长上下文多模态推理的人有参考意义。UGC-AVQA 也提供了一个更偏“音画关联”的评测切面，能减少模型只靠视觉先验答题的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文包含两部分。第一是 UGC-AVQA，一个面向用户生成短视频的音画关联 benchmark。样本来自公开短视频平台，共 1,000 个视频、4,816 个 QA。问题覆盖音画事件推进、场景或时间转移、跨场景音画对齐、细粒度音画对比。关键过滤步骤是 audio removal check：去掉音轨后让 Gemini-3.1-Flash 回答，只有模型在无音频条件下失败的样本才保留，以降低纯视觉可解的比例。第二是 OMAC/O-MARC。OMAC 是 training-free 插件式压缩方法，保留紧凑视觉 memory 和时间锚定的 audio anchors，并用视觉 memory 的分布来分配音频预算。这个设计的动机是：视觉里常有更稳定的场景结构，音频里可能有短但决定性的片段，因此音频压缩预算需要受视觉事件分布约束，而不是平均采样或孤立压缩。O-MARC 则进一步做 compression distillation，让较小模型在被压缩的多模态上下文上学习推理，减少推理时压缩分布和训练时完整上下文之间的不匹配。
summary.experiments: 数据方面，UGC-AVQA 的 benchmark split 包含 206 个视频、1,648 个 QA；其余 794 个视频作为训练 split。作者对 benchmark 候选和生成训练样本各抽取 30% 进行人工复核和修正。模型方面，实验覆盖 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B、7B、30B 量级。OMAC 在相近推理成本下优于直接 token compression。O-MARC 在 3B 设置下带来更明显收益；扩展到 7B 后，在总体平均分上超过同期训练式压缩 baseline。论文提供的片段没有完整表格数值，精确提升幅度需要看实验主表和各类别 breakdown。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。重点看三处：第一，UGC-AVQA 的构造流程，尤其是 audio removal check，这决定了评测是否真的需要音频；第二，OMAC 的 token budget 分配和视觉 memory/audio anchors 设计，这是方法的核心；第三，3B/7B/30B 上 compression ratio、准确率和推理成本的对照表。若只关心预训练，可重点看它对多模态 token 压缩训练分布的启发，而不必深读 benchmark 样例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies efficient audiovisual reasoning for omnimodal LLMs. Joint audio-video inputs create long token sequences, while naive compression can remove the short acoustic cues and cross-modal alignments needed for answering.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model research is mainly in multimodal token budgeting and the train–inference interface for compressed contexts. The useful lesson is that audio and video should not be compressed independently: decisive evidence often lies in the temporal relation between what is heard and what is seen. The UGC-AVQA benchmark is also useful as an evaluation slice for native multimodal models because it explicitly filters out questions solvable from visual priors alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has two components. UGC-AVQA is a user-generated-video benchmark with 1,000 videos and 4,816 QA pairs, targeting audiovisual event progression, scene or temporal transitions, cross-scene alignment, and fine-grained contrast. A key design step is an audio-removal check: after removing the audio track, Gemini-3.1-Flash is asked to answer; only samples that fail under this setting are retained. On the method side, OMAC is a training-free plug-in compression method. It keeps compact visual memory and temporally grounded audio anchors, then allocates audio budget according to the visual memory distribution. This differs from modality-isolated compression because visual structure is used to guide where audio evidence should be preserved. O-MARC adds compression distillation, training the model to reason over memory-compressed multimodal contexts so that inference-time compressed inputs are less out-of-distribution.
summary_en.experiments: UGC-AVQA contains a benchmark split with 206 videos and 1,648 QA pairs, while the remaining 794 videos form the training split. The authors manually review and correct 30% of both benchmark candidates and generated training examples. Experiments are reported on Qwen2.5-Omni models at 3B, 7B, and 30B scales. OMAC improves over direct token compression at comparable inference cost. O-MARC gives stronger gains in the 3B setting, and the 7B version outperforms a contemporary training-based compression baseline on the overall average. Exact per-category gains require the full result tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the UGC-AVQA construction pipeline, especially the audio-removal filter; the OMAC memory and audio-anchor mechanism; and the main tables comparing compression ratio, accuracy, and inference cost across 3B/7B/30B models. Readers interested in multimodal pretraining should look for how compressed-context distillation changes the model’s operating distribution, rather than spending too much time on individual QA examples.

recommendation.zh: 免训练的多模态token压缩方法有实用价值，核心看§3的OMAC设计和§4的蒸馏框架，基准构建也值得参考
recommendation.en: The training-free multimodal token compression method has practical value. Focus on §3 for OMAC design and §4 for the distillation framework; the benchmark construction is also worth referencing.

paper.title: DynFrame: Adaptive Reasoning-Driven Multimodal Framework with Dynamic Frame Augmentation for Complex Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Recent video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly couple step-by-step reasoning with on-demand visual evidence retrieval, allowing models to revisit relevant video segments during inference. However, two structural gaps remain in existing thinking-with-video systems. (i) Sampling density is not a learnable decision: existing methods may let the model decide where to look, but the per-window frame rate is largely fixed. As a result, fine-grained evidence is often recovered throug

summary.core_problem: 现有视频多模态大模型的帧采样密度固定、检索与生成的优化信号未拆分，导致复杂视频推理时检索开销大、训练难度高。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将采样密度作为可学习token融入自回归流程，拆分了检索与生成阶段的监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DynFrame框架，在自回归生成中直接输出时间窗口与采样密度token，独立优化检索动作与答案生成两条轨迹的优势信号。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模，在复杂视频理解基准上验证了采样密度自适应可降低检索次数与上下文长度。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video MLLMs use fixed frame sampling density and shared optimization signals for retrieval and generation, leading to high retrieval overhead and training difficulty in complex video reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first to model sampling density as learnable tokens in autoregressive pass and decouple supervision signals for retrieval and generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DynFrame framework, which emits temporal window and sampling density as native tokens during autoregressive generation, and optimizes advantage signals for retrieval action and answer generation trajectories separately.
summary_en.experiments: Specific model size and training data scale not disclosed. Verified on complex video understanding benchmarks that adaptive sampling density reduces retrieval calls and context length.

recommendation.zh: 多模态推理流程的小改进，检索与生成监督拆分的思路对通用Agent的动作-回答信用分配有微弱参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Minor improvement to multimodal reasoning pipeline. The idea of decoupling retrieval and generation supervision has weak reference for general agent action-answer credit assignment; no need for in-depth reading.

paper.title: MetaphorVU: Towards Metaphorical Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Metaphorical videos are prevalent across various real-world scenarios to convey complex ideas, and understanding them typically requires high-order cognitive capabilities. The lack of systematic studies on metaphorical video understanding not only constrains the real-world applicability of MLLMs but also impedes the thorough assessment of their high-order cognitive capabilities. To bridge this gap, we propose MetaphorVU-Bench, the first systematic and comprehensive benchmark dedicated to metapho

summary.core_problem: 解决当前多模态大模型缺少系统性“隐喻视频理解”评测的问题，并分析它们在跨域映射这类高阶认知能力上的短板。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测资产与任务定义：提出首个较系统的隐喻视频理解benchmark，并给出错误归因和一个推理时增强方法。对研究多模态推理边界、评测盲区和高阶语义对齐有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建MetaphorVU-Bench，系统覆盖隐喻视频理解任务；实验发现现有MLLM主要卡在cross-domain mapping。基于这一分析，作者进一步构建metaphor knowledge graph，并提出推理时增强框架MetaphorBoost，用知识映射辅助模型理解隐喻。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明作者比较了当前主流MLLM与人类表现，发现模型显著落后于人类，并通过MetaphorBoost获得稳定提升。摘要未给出具体模型名单、样本规模和提升幅度，但benchmark属性明确强于方法属性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of a systematic benchmark for metaphorical video understanding and analyzes where current multimodal LLMs fail on this higher-order reasoning capability.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation asset and task definition: a dedicated benchmark for metaphorical video understanding, plus an error analysis and an inference-time enhancement method. It is relevant if you care about blind spots in multimodal reasoning evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces MetaphorVU-Bench to cover metaphorical video understanding systematically. It finds that current MLLMs mainly fail at cross-domain mapping, then builds a metaphor knowledge graph and proposes MetaphorBoost, an inference-time augmentation framework that injects mapping knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract indicates comparisons between current MLLMs and humans, showing a large human-model gap, and reports consistent gains from MetaphorBoost. It does not provide exact model names, benchmark size, or numerical improvements, but the benchmark contribution is clearly primary.

recommendation.zh: 评测比方法更有价值：如果你做多模态预训练，记住‘模型不缺感知，缺跨域映射’这个失败模式；正文只看benchmark设计和误差分析。
recommendation.en: The benchmark matters more than the method: for multimodal pretraining, the useful takeaway is that models fail more on cross-domain mapping than raw perception; read the benchmark design and error analysis only.

paper.title: Cambrian-P: Pose-Grounded Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Camera pose matters. The position and orientation of each viewpoint define a shared spatial coordinate frame that relates observations across video frames. Yet this signal is largely absent from multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) for video understanding, which process frames as isolated 2D snapshots, instead of the persistent scene humans perceive. We revisit pose as a lightweight supervisory signal and introduce Cambrian-P, a video MLLM augmented with per-frame learnable camera tokens and a pose regressio

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 MLLM 把帧当作独立 2D 图像处理，缺乏统一空间坐标系，因而在空间推理和场景持续性理解上表现受限的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态理解方向较有意思的一篇：它把 camera pose 作为轻量监督信号接入视频 MLLM，属于对视频原生建模假设的修正。对做统一多模态预训练的人有启发，但离 LLM 文本基座主线仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Cambrian-P，在视频 MLLM 中加入每帧可学习 camera tokens 和 pose regression head，并设计采样策略利用 pose 监督。训练时既可用真实 pose，也可用 in-the-wild 视频的 pseudo pose 标注。核心思想是把相机位姿作为跨帧共享坐标框架，帮助模型建立 persistent scene representation，而不是只做逐帧视觉问答。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告在 VSI-Bench 等空间推理 benchmark 上提升 4.5-6.5%，并泛化到另外 8 个空间与通用视频 QA benchmark；同时在 ScanNet 上达到 streaming pose estimation 的最好结果。一个值得注意的实验点是：用野外视频的伪 pose 标注训练，连一般视频 QA 也继续提升，说明 pose 监督不只改善显式空间题。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 New York University；Saining Xie 是视觉与多模态方向较活跃研究者，Cambrian 系列也有一定代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of video MLLMs: they often process frames as isolated 2D snapshots, lacking a shared spatial coordinate frame for persistent scene understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is a meaningful multimodal understanding paper. It injects camera pose as lightweight supervision into a video MLLM, effectively revising the modeling assumption for native video understanding. It is relevant for unified multimodal pretraining, though less so for core text LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cambrian-P augments a video MLLM with per-frame learnable camera tokens and a pose regression head, together with a tailored sampling scheme for pose supervision. The key idea is to use camera pose as a shared coordinate system across frames, enabling persistent scene representations rather than treating video as frame-wise QA. Training can use either ground-truth poses or pseudo-annotated poses from in-the-wild videos.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports gains of 4.5-6.5% on spatial reasoning benchmarks such as VSI-Bench, with generalization to eight additional spatial and general video QA benchmarks. As a byproduct, the model reaches state-of-the-art streaming pose estimation on ScanNet. A notable result is that training on pseudo-annotated in-the-wild poses also improves general video QA, suggesting pose supervision helps beyond explicitly spatial tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from New York University. Saining Xie is a well-known researcher in vision and multimodal learning, and the Cambrian line has some visibility in the field.

recommendation.zh: 它在提醒一件常被忽略的事：视频预训练缺的可能不是更多帧，而是显式坐标系；读摘要、方法图和 pose ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: The useful takeaway is that video pretraining may be bottlenecked less by more frames than by an explicit coordinate frame; the abstract, method figure, and pose ablations are enough.

paper.title: See What I Mean: Aligning Vision and Language Representations for Video Fine-grained Object Understanding
paper.abstract: We present SWIM (See What I Mean), a novel training strategy that aligns vision and language representations to enable fine-grained object understanding solely from textual prompts. Unlike existing approaches that require explicit visual prompts, such as masks or points, SWIM leverages mask supervision only during training to guide cross-modal attention, allowing the model to automatically attend to the user-specified object at inference. Our cross-attention analysis of pretrained multimodal lar

summary.core_problem: 让多模态大模型在视频中仅根据文本提示定位并理解细粒度目标，而不需要推理阶段的 mask、point 等显式视觉提示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 对齐训练策略和数据构造。它对通用 LLM 预训练的直接信息较少，但关于跨注意力中 object noun 与 attribute word 的激活差异，可能对多模态表示对齐有参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SWIM 训练策略：训练时使用 mask supervision 引导 cross-modal attention，推理时只输入自然语言 referring expression。作者构建 NL-Refer 数据集，将每个 object mask 与精确自然语言指代表达配对，并从 object nouns 提取多层 cross-attention map 来缓解名词对应视觉区域分散的问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出视频数据规模、模型 backbone、训练成本、baseline 名称或具体指标。它声称基于预训练 MLLM 的 cross-attention 分析发现属性词激活更局部，而物体名词激活更分散。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Nankai University VCIP 和 Alibaba Group Tongyi Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make multimodal LLMs understand fine-grained objects in video from text prompts alone, without visual prompts such as masks or points at inference time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM alignment strategy and dataset construction. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but its analysis of noun and attribute attention patterns may be useful for multimodal representation alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWIM uses mask supervision only during training to guide cross-modal attention, while inference relies on natural-language referring expressions. The authors build NL-Refer, pairing object masks with precise referring expressions, and extract multi-layer cross-attention maps from object nouns to correct diffuse object grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide dataset size, model backbone, training cost, baselines, or numerical gains. It reports an attention analysis where attribute words produce sharper localized visual activations than object nouns.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Nankai University VCIP and Alibaba Group Tongyi Lab.

recommendation.zh: 偏视频目标理解下游；只记住 noun/attribute attention mismatch，别把它当通用 VLM 预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Mostly downstream video grounding; keep the noun/attribute attention mismatch, but do not overread it as a general VLM pretraining result.

paper.title: Perception or Prejudice: Can MLLMs Go Beyond First Impressions of Personality?
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in human-facing roles where personality perception is critical, yet existing benchmarks evaluate this capability solely on numerical Big Five score prediction, leaving open whether models truly perceive personality through behavioral understanding or merely prejudge through superficial pattern matching. We address this gap with three contributions. (i) A new task: we formalize Grounded Personality Reasoning (GPR), which requires

summary.core_problem: 评估 MLLM 在人格感知任务中是否真的基于可观察行为推理，而不是只根据外观或第一印象做标签预测。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个多模态人格推理任务、视频数据集和分层评测协议。它对 VLM 对齐和社会感知能力评估有参考意义，但任务较专门，离 LLM 基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Grounded Personality Reasoning，要求模型完成评分、理由生成和证据 grounding。数据集 MM-OCEAN 包含视频、Big Five 相关问题、时间戳行为观察、证据支撑的人格分析，以及七类 cue-grounding 多选题；数据由 multi-agent pipeline 生成并经人工验证。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 1,104 个视频和 5,320 道 MCQ。评测分为 rating、reasoning、grounding 三层，并加入四类样本级 failure-mode 指标。摘要未列出具体模型列表、分数、领先模型表现或显著提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The University of Tokyo、Shanda AI Research Tokyo 和 Dalian University of Technology；作者中 Huchuan Lu、Yoichi Sato、Kaipeng Zhang 在视觉和多模态研究中较有辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether MLLMs infer personality from observable behavior, rather than relying on superficial first impressions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal personality-reasoning task, a video dataset, and a layered evaluation protocol. It is relevant to VLM alignment and social-perception evaluation, but the task is specialized and not central to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Grounded Personality Reasoning, where models must produce a rating, a rationale, and evidence grounding. The MM-OCEAN dataset includes videos, Big Five questions, timestamped behavioral observations, evidence-grounded trait analyses, and seven categories of cue-grounding MCQs, generated by a multi-agent pipeline with human verification.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 1,104 videos and 5,320 multiple-choice questions. Evaluation is organized into rating, reasoning, and grounding tiers, with four sample-level failure-mode metrics. The abstract does not report the evaluated model set, exact scores, or quantitative margins.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include The University of Tokyo, Shanda AI Research Tokyo, and Dalian University of Technology. Huchuan Lu, Yoichi Sato, and Kaipeng Zhang are recognizable names in vision and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和 failure-mode 指标即可；这是 VLM 社会感知评测，不会改变预训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the task definition and failure-mode metrics only; this is a VLM social-perception benchmark, not a signal that changes pretraining recipes.

paper.title: Swift Sampling: Selecting Temporal Surprises via Taylor Series
paper.abstract: While most frames in long-form video are redundant, the critical information resides in temporal surprises: moments where the actual visual features deviate from their predicted evolution. Inspired by the human brain's predictive coding, we introduce Swift Sampling, an elegant, training-free frame selection algorithm that automatically identifies high-information moments in a video. Specifically, we model a video as a differentiable trajectory in the visual latent space and compute the velocity

summary.core_problem: 长视频中大多数帧冗余，问题是如何在不训练额外模型的情况下选择对视频理解最有信息量的关键帧。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是轻量视频采样方法。对 VLM 长视频理解有间接价值，因为视觉 token 预算通常远小于视频原始长度，好的采样策略会影响推理成本和信息保真。
summary.technical_approach: Swift Sampling 将视频表示为视觉 latent space 中的可微轨迹，计算特征速度和加速度，用 Taylor 展开预测后续帧的期望路径；实际特征显著偏离预测流形的帧被定义为 temporal surprises 并被选中。方法是 training-free，不依赖额外网络或视频特定调参。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法相对 baseline 只增加 0.02x 计算开销，并比已有领先方法的额外开销低约 30 倍。完整实验需要正文确认具体视频任务、VLM/视觉编码器、采样率、基线和准确率变化。

summary_en.core_problem: Long videos contain many redundant frames, and the paper asks how to select high-information frames without training an additional model.
summary_en.importance: This is a lightweight video sampling method. It is indirectly relevant to VLMs because visual-token budgets are much smaller than raw video length, so sampling affects both inference cost and information retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Swift Sampling treats a video as a differentiable trajectory in visual latent space, computes velocity and acceleration, uses Taylor expansion to predict the expected future path, and selects frames whose features deviate sharply from that predicted manifold. The method is training-free and avoids auxiliary networks or video-specific tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports only 0.02x additional compute over a baseline and about 30x lower overhead than a leading alternative. The main paper is needed for task suites, VLM or encoder choices, sampling rates, baselines, and accuracy trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表；它是视频 token 预算下的实用 trick，不是多模态预训练新信号。
recommendation.en: Only inspect the method figure and main tables; it is a practical video-token budgeting trick, not a new multimodal pretraining signal.

paper.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in general video understanding, yet they often struggle with the fine-grained comprehension crucial for real-world applications requiring nuanced interpretation of human actions and interactions. While some recent human-centric benchmarks evaluate aspects of model behaviour such as fairness/ethics, emotion perception, and broader human-centric metrics, they do not combine long-form videos, very dense QA coverage, and frame-l

summary.core_problem: FineBench 关注视频 VLM 在细粒度、以人为中心的行为理解上的评测缺口。已有视频 VQA 更偏整体场景、粗粒度活动或短视频问答，难以测出模型是否真正理解多人场景中的动作细节、交互关系、时序变化和空间指代。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献不在训练方法，而在评测信号。它把视频理解失败点从“看不懂视频”拆成更具体的问题：物体操作相对容易，人类动作、人物交互、多主体指代和空间定位仍然薄弱。对 native multimodal 预训练有启发：仅靠视频级 caption、粗粒度 QA 或稀疏帧监督，很难迫使模型学到稳定的人物级 grounding 与时序细节。
summary.technical_approach: FineBench 基于 AVA v2.2 的密集标注构造多选视频问答，覆盖 Person Movement、Person Interaction、Object Manipulation 三类问题，并显式加入空间和时间 grounding。数据规模为 64 个长视频、199,420 个 QA，平均每个视频约 3,116 个问题，约 785 个关键帧关联。它的关键设计不是扩大视频数量，而是提高单个长视频上的标注密度，用密集问题测试模型在同一上下文内区分不同人物、动作、时间片和物体关系的能力。论文还提出 FineAgent，用 Localizer 提供 bounding box 信息，缓解多人物指代混淆；用 Descriptor 生成帧级摘要，补充语义上下文。这是对现有 VLM 的外部增强，不是新的端到端预训练范式。
summary.experiments: 论文评测了闭源和开源 VLM。结果显示模型能力分布很不均衡：Object Manipulation 通常能达到 high 80s，而 Person Movement 和 Person Interaction 往往下降到 50s 和 60s。强闭源模型最高约 77% accuracy，说明 benchmark 尚未饱和。进一步分析显示，场景中人物数量增加时准确率明显下降，问题主要来自空间推理、主体消歧和细微动作识别。FineAgent 在多个开源 VLM 上带来提升，原因是它把模型原本需要隐式完成的定位和帧级语义抽取显式化；但从给出的正文内容看，具体提升幅度和逐模型数字需要查表确认。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Table 1，理解 FineBench 与 VideoMME、EgoSchema、MVBench、TemporalBench 等 benchmark 的差异；看 Section 3.3 和 Table 3，关注不同动作类型之间的性能分裂；看 Section 3.4 和 Figure 3，理解多人场景为何仍是 VLM 的短板；FineAgent 部分可以快速看 Localizer 与 Descriptor 的输入输出形式，判断这种外部工具增强是否能转化为未来预训练数据或监督目标。

summary_en.core_problem: FineBench targets a specific evaluation gap in video VLMs: fine-grained, human-centric activity understanding. Existing video QA benchmarks often test coarse scene understanding or sparse temporal reasoning, but they do not sufficiently probe subtle human motion, interactions, spatial reference, and temporal grounding in long videos.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. The benchmark shows that current VLMs are not uniformly weak on video: they handle object manipulation much better than human movement and interaction. This distinction matters for multimodal pretraining, because coarse video captions or sparse QA supervision are unlikely to teach robust person-level grounding, subject disambiguation, and temporally precise action understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: FineBench is a dense multiple-choice VQA benchmark built from AVA v2.2 annotations. It contains 199,420 QA pairs over 64 long-form videos, with about 3,116 questions and 785 linked keyframes per video. The benchmark covers Person Movement, Person Interaction, and Object Manipulation, with explicit spatial and temporal grounding. Its design choice is to increase annotation density per long video rather than simply increasing the number of clips. The paper also introduces FineAgent, a modular enhancement pipeline. A Localizer supplies bounding boxes to reduce subject ambiguity, and a Descriptor produces frame-level summaries to enrich semantic context. This is an inference-time augmentation around existing VLMs, not a new pretraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both proprietary and open-source VLMs. The key result is a large gap across action types: models score in the high 80s on Object Manipulation, but often fall into the 50s and 60s on Person Movement and Person Interaction. The best proprietary model reaches around 77% accuracy, leaving clear headroom. Error analysis shows a marked drop as the number of people in the scene increases, pointing to persistent failures in spatial reasoning and subject disambiguation. FineAgent improves several open-source VLMs by making localization and frame-level description explicit, although the provided text does not expose the full per-model gain table.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read Table 1 to understand how FineBench differs from VideoMME, EgoSchema, MVBench, and TemporalBench. Then read Section 3.3 and Table 3 for the action-type breakdown. Section 3.4 and Figure 3 are the most useful diagnostic parts, especially the analysis of multi-person degradation. The FineAgent section is worth scanning for its decomposition into localization and description, and for thinking about whether these signals should be moved from inference-time tools into multimodal pretraining data.

recommendation.zh: 作为 video VLM eval 备查即可；看数据构成和错误类型，没必要按方法论文精读。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a video-VLM evaluation reference; inspect the dataset design and error taxonomy, not the whole paper.

paper.title: HAVEN: Hierarchically Aligned Multimodal Benchmark for Unified Video Understanding
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong performance on standard video tasks, their ability to faithfully summarize and reason over complex narratives remains poorly evaluated. Existing summarization benchmarks fragment supervision across isolated granularities, such as keyframes, key shots, or disjointed text summaries, failing to capture the inherently hierarchical structure of cross-modal alignment. To address this critical gap, we introduce HAVEN, a hierarchically aligne

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型视频理解benchmark采用孤立粒度的监督，未覆盖跨模态对齐的分层结构，无法准确评测模型对复杂叙事的摘要与推理能力
summary.importance: benchmark贡献，首次提出全粒度、全模态分层对齐的视频理解评测数据集，填补了跨模态分层对齐评测的空白
summary.technical_approach: 构建覆盖帧、镜头、视频三个层级的显式跨模态对齐标注，设计包含摘要、时序推理、多模态grounding、显著性排序的综合评测套件
summary.experiments: 对当前SOTA多模态大模型进行基准测试，验证现有模型在分层跨模态理解任务上存在显著性能缺口
summary.authors_note: 夏威夷大学马诺阿分校研究团队，无公开知名相关领域作者

summary_en.core_problem: Existing MLLM video understanding benchmarks use isolated granularity supervision, ignore the hierarchical structure of cross-modal alignment, and cannot accurately evaluate models' summarization and reasoning ability for complex narratives
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution, the first fully granular, fully multimodal hierarchically aligned video understanding evaluation dataset, filling the gap of cross-modal hierarchical alignment evaluation
summary_en.technical_approach: Build explicit cross-modal alignment annotations covering frame, shot, video three levels, design a comprehensive evaluation suite including summarization, temporal reasoning, multimodal grounding, and saliency ranking
summary_en.experiments: Benchmark current SOTA MLLMs, verify that existing models have significant performance gaps in hierarchical cross-modal understanding tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Research team from University of Hawaii at Manoa, no well-known authors in related fields publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 视频多模态理解领域的新增基准，仅在需要做分层对齐评测时备查，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: New benchmark for video multimodal understanding, only for reference when hierarchical alignment evaluation is needed, no need to read full text

paper.title: LMM-Track4D: Eliciting 4D Dynamic Reasoning in LMMs via Trajectory-Grounded Dialogue
paper.abstract: Recent large multimodal models (LMMs) have become increasingly capable on image and video understanding, yet still struggle to sustain 4D continuous spatiotemporal dynamic reasoning. To study this capability gap, we formulate trajectory-grounded multi-turn spatiotemporal dialogue, a new task in which a model must answer spatiotemporal queries while returning structured 3D target trajectories over an entire short clip or a specified segment of a longer clip, and introduce Track4D-Bench, a benchma

summary.core_problem: 现有大多模态模型难以支撑连续4D时空动态推理，缺乏对应的标准化任务定义与评测基准
summary.importance: 提出全新的轨迹锚定多轮时空对话任务范式，构建了Track4D-Bench评测基准，同时提出适配4D推理的多模态建模方法，属于任务创新+benchmark贡献
summary.technical_approach: 提出LMM-Track4D框架，核心包含三个模块：射线-时间几何编码（RTGE）、专用流状态token TRK用于长时序动态传播、OSK-RA解码器用于遮挡和视角变化下的稳定3D状态估计
summary.experiments: Track4D-Bench包含526个clip级对话样本，覆盖23.5k帧、7.5k个物体标注，LMM-Track4D在该基准上对比现有LMM基线取得一致性效果提升
summary.authors_note: 作者来自华中科技大学、中山大学、北京航空航天大学、北京大学

summary_en.core_problem: Existing large multimodal models (LMMs) cannot support sustained 4D continuous spatiotemporal dynamic reasoning, and there is no standardized task formulation or evaluation benchmark for this capability
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel trajectory-grounded multi-turn spatiotemporal dialogue paradigm, builds the Track4D-Bench benchmark, and develops an LMM architecture tailored for 4D reasoning, contributing to task innovation and benchmark construction
summary_en.technical_approach: The LMM-Track4D framework includes three core components: Ray-Time Geometry Encoding (RTGE), a dedicated streaming state token TRK for long-horizon dynamic propagation, and an OSK-RA decoder for stable 3D state estimation under occlusion and viewpoint variation
summary_en.experiments: Track4D-Bench contains 526 clip-level dialogue samples covering 23.5k frames and 7.5k object annotations, and LMM-Track4D achieves consistent performance improvements over existing LMM baselines on this benchmark
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Sun Yat-sen University, Beihang University, and Peking University

recommendation.zh: 多模态特定推理能力的增量工作，仅了解benchmark任务设置即可，无需复现方法
recommendation.en: Incremental work on domain-specific multimodal reasoning, only the benchmark task setup is worth noting, no need to reproduce the method

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: CoRDS: Coreset-based Representative and Diverse Selection for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding with large vision-language models (VLMs) requires a compact memory that can support future reasoning over an ever-growing visual history. A common solution is to compress the key-value (KV) cache, but existing streaming methods typically rely on local token-wise heuristics, such as recency, temporal redundancy, or saliency, which do not explicitly optimize whether the retained cache is representative of the accumulated history. We propose to view KV-cache compressio

summary.core_problem: 流式视频理解中VLM的KV缓存压缩依赖局部token级启发式方法（如新近性、时间冗余），未显式优化保留内容是否代表累积视觉历史。
summary.importance: 方法创新：将KV缓存压缩视为coreset选择问题，在联合KV表示空间中做几何覆盖优化。
summary.technical_approach: CoRDS方法：(1)双准则目标平衡key和value空间的覆盖度，同时保留检索结构和输出相关信息；(2)正交性驱动的多样性准则促进保留子集的多样性。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解任务上验证，据称优于局部启发式方法。
summary.authors_note: UBC、Vector Institute，Leonid Sigal是资深CV/VLM领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: KV-cache compression for streaming video understanding with VLMs relies on local token-wise heuristics (recency, temporal redundancy, saliency) that do not explicitly optimize whether retained content represents accumulated visual history.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes KV-cache compression as a coreset selection problem, optimizing geometric coverage in joint KV representation space.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoRDS method: (1) bicriteria objective balancing coverage in key and value spaces, preserving both retrieval structure and output-relevant information; (2) orthogonality-driven diversity criterion for diverse retained subsets.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on streaming video understanding tasks, outperforming local heuristic methods.
summary_en.authors_note: UBC, Vector Institute; Leonid Sigal is a well-known researcher in CV/VLM.

recommendation.zh: 将coreset方法应用于KV缓存压缩是新颖视角，但属于视频VLM推理优化，对LLM基座预训练研究员参考价值有限，仅作方法灵感参考。
recommendation.en: Coreset-based KV compression is a novel perspective but limited to video VLM inference optimization; minimal relevance for LLM foundation pretraining; reference for method inspiration only.

paper.title: Video-Zero: Self-Evolution Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Self-evolution offers a promising path for improving reasoning models without relying on intensive human annotation. However, extending this paradigm to video understanding remains underexplored and challenging: videos are long, dynamic, and redundant, while the evidence needed for reasoning is often sparse and temporally localized. Naively generating difficult question-answer pairs from full videos can therefore produce supervision that appears challenging but is weakly grounded, relying on sta

summary.core_problem: 现有自进化范式迁移到视频理解领域时存在两个核心瓶颈：一是基于全视频生成的问答对依赖静态视觉或语言先验，未锚定关键时序证据；二是仅以问题难度为优化目标，忽略问题与视频内容的相关性，导致生成的监督信号弱、落地性差。
summary.importance: 提出了无需人工标注的视频多模态大模型自进化路径，为降低视频VLM预训练/微调阶段的标注成本、提升时序推理能力提供了可复用的设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: 采用问答生成器-求解器的协同进化框架，核心设计有三点：1）问答生成器先定位视频中的关键时序证据段，再基于证据段生成问答对，避免全视频无焦点生成；2）生成器的奖励函数同时覆盖可学习性、视频依赖性、证据质量三个维度，不再仅依赖难度指标；3）求解器训练时加入推理证据的时序对齐损失，避免模型依赖答案捷径。
summary.experiments: 在13个视频理解基准上测试了Qwen3-VL、MiMo-VL、InternVL3.5三个系列模型，在时序定位、长视频理解、视频推理三类任务上均获得一致的性能提升，全程未使用人工标注数据。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法章节的证据定位机制和奖励函数设计、实验部分的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing self-evolution paradigms face two key bottlenecks when adapted to video understanding: first, QA pairs generated from full videos rely on static visual or language priors instead of grounded temporal evidence; second, optimization only targets question difficulty while ignoring relevance between questions and video content, leading to weak, poorly grounded supervision signals.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes an annotation-free self-evolution pipeline for video multimodal large models, providing reusable design insights for reducing annotation cost in video VLM pretraining/finetuning and improving temporal reasoning capability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework adopts a Questioner-Solver co-evolution loop with three core designs: 1) The Questioner first locates key temporal evidence spans in the video, then generates QA pairs conditioned on these spans to avoid unfocused full-video generation; 2) The reward function for the Questioner covers learnability, video dependency, and evidence quality, instead of using difficulty as the only metric; 3) A temporal alignment loss for reasoning evidence is added to the Solver's training objective to prevent answer shortcut reliance.
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted across 13 video understanding benchmarks on three model families: Qwen3-VL, MiMo-VL, and InternVL3.5. Consistent performance gains are observed on temporal grounding, long-video understanding, and video reasoning tasks, with no human annotation used during the entire process.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the evidence localization mechanism and reward function design in the method section, as well as ablation study results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇真正值得看的点不是视频，而是它把自进化监督的核心从“更难”改成“更有证据”；只看问题生成与 grounding ablation 就够了。
recommendation.en: The real value is not video but the shift from “harder self-evolution” to “better-grounded self-evolution”; read the question-generation and grounding ablations, not the whole benchmark parade.

paper.title: X2SAM: Any Segmentation in Images and Videos
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong image-level visual understanding and reasoning, yet their pixel-level perception across both images and videos remains limited. Foundation segmentation models such as the SAM series produce high-quality masks, but they rely on low-level visual prompts and cannot natively interpret complex conversational instructions. Existing segmentation MLLMs narrow this gap, but are usually specialized for either images or videos and rarely sup

summary.core_problem: 让多模态大模型在图像和视频中统一支持由对话指令与视觉提示驱动的像素级分割。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态像素级感知系统：把LLM的语言交互能力和SAM类分割能力结合，并扩展到视频时间一致性。它与VLM grounding有关，但主要仍是分割下游系统，不是通用多模态预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: X2SAM将LLM与分割模块耦合，引入Mask Memory存储由提示引导得到的视觉特征，用于视频中时间一致的mask生成。同一接口支持文本提示、视觉提示、开放词表分割、指代表达分割、推理分割、grounded conversation和交互式分割等任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、baseline名称或具体分数；声称覆盖图像与视频、多类提示和多种分割任务，但从给定信息无法判断泛化是否来自统一训练还是任务集合堆叠。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中山大学和鹏城实验室；Xiaodan Liang是视觉理解与多模态方向较活跃的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to give multimodal large language models unified pixel-level segmentation capability over both images and videos using conversational instructions and visual prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multimodal pixel-level perception system: it connects LLM-based language interaction with SAM-style segmentation and extends the setup to temporally consistent video masks. It is relevant to VLM grounding, but remains primarily a downstream segmentation system rather than a general multimodal pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: X2SAM couples an LLM with a segmentation module and introduces a Mask Memory component that stores prompt-guided visual features for temporally consistent video mask generation. The same interface supports textual prompts, visual prompts, open-vocabulary segmentation, referring segmentation, reasoning segmentation, grounded conversation, and interactive segmentation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data scale, baseline names, or numerical results. It claims broad coverage across image and video segmentation tasks and prompt types, but the provided information is insufficient to judge whether the gains come from unified learning or task aggregation.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include Sun Yat-Sen University and Peng Cheng Laboratory. Xiaodan Liang is an active researcher in visual understanding and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 可作为VLM像素grounding系统备查；只看Mask Memory设计，别把它当预训练范式论文读。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM pixel-grounding system reference; read the Mask Memory design only, not as a pretraining-paradigm paper.

paper.title: DenseStep2M: A Scalable, Training-Free Pipeline for Dense Instructional Video Annotation
paper.abstract: Long-term video understanding requires interpreting complex temporal events and reasoning over procedural activities. While instructional video corpora, like HowTo100M, offer rich resources for model training, they present significant challenges, including noisy ASR transcripts and inconsistent temporal alignments between narration and visual content. In this work, we introduce an automated, training-free pipeline to extract high-quality procedural annotations from in-the-wild instructional vide

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是视频理解模型本身，而是一个更前置的问题：怎样把 HowTo100M 这类噪声很大的野生 instructional video，自动转成可用于训练长时程视频-语言模型的高质量、时序对齐、步骤级标注数据。难点有两个。第一，ASR 文本噪声重，口语化、指代多、冗余多。第二，讲解和实际动作经常不同步，旁白可能早于或晚于视觉动作。如果直接拿原始 transcript 训练，模型学到的是错位的语言-视觉对应关系，长视频 procedural reasoning 会被系统性污染。论文的目标，是在不额外训练标注模型的前提下，用现成 VLM/LLM 搭出一个可扩展的数据生产流水线，把长视频切成视觉一致的片段，生成步骤描述，再做语义和时间上的校正与合并。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在数据工程，而不是模型结构。它提供了一个较完整的范式：当原始多模态语料规模很大但对齐质量差时，可以先做结构化重建，再把数据喂给下游预训练或微调。这个思路对视频预训练、长时程 VLM、甚至语音/视频统一建模都成立。贡献量级上，它不是提出新的预训练目标，而是证明了“高质量自动重标注”本身可以成为数据放大器：从约 10 万 instructional videos 中抽取出 200 万条细粒度 procedural steps，并且这些自动标注在人工基准上接近可用，进一步带来 dense captioning、procedural grounding、cross-modal retrieval 的一致提升。对做 pretrain 的人，真正有启发的是数据清洗、时序切分、候选生成、推理式精修这条链路，而不是单点模型性能。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是视频过滤与分段。作者从 HowTo100M 中筛 instructional videos，并把长视频切成视觉上相对一致的 shots。这里的目的不是传统镜头检测本身，而是给后续步骤生成提供更稳定的局部上下文，避免一个 prompt 同时覆盖多个动作。与此同时，还会过滤视觉-文本明显失配的内容，减少后续大模型在坏样本上“硬解释”。第二段是候选步骤生成。作者使用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 联合看视频帧和对应 transcript，为每个 shot 生成候选 procedural step。这里关键不是简单 caption，而是要求输出结构化、可执行、与片段绑定的步骤描述，因此它更接近 procedural abstraction：把口语化 narration 和视觉动作压缩成规范步骤。第三段是步骤精修与合并。作者用 DeepSeek-R1 对候选步骤做两类处理：一类是语义清洗，把含糊指代、口语冗余、碎片化表达改写成更清晰的 instruction-like step；另一类是时间修正与跨 shot 合并，把被切碎的同一动作合并，或把错位的描述重新对齐到更合理的时间段。这个设计体现了明确分工：Qwen2.5-VL 负责感知与局部 grounding，DeepSeek-R1 负责长上下文推理、重写和全局一致性整理。相比早期直接用单个 AR 模型从 transcript 生成步骤，这里更强调“先局部感知，再全局整理”，原因是长视频中的误差主要来自局部视觉遗漏和全局时间错配，两者需要不同能力的模型处理。论文还构建了 DenseCaption100 作为 100 个视频的人写 dense annotation benchmark，用来验证自动流水线的质量，而不是只看下游任务分数。
summary.experiments: 数据侧，最终得到 DenseStep2M：约 100K instructional videos、约 2M fine-grained procedural steps，平均每个视频对应多条时序步骤。验证侧，作者人工构建 DenseCaption100，对自动标注与人工标注做对齐评估。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文描述看，自动生成结果在语义相关性和时间对齐上都达到较强的人类一致性，说明这套 training-free pipeline 不是只会生成流畅文本，而是真能提供可训练的时序 supervision。应用侧，作者把 DenseStep2M 用于微调 vision-language models，在生成式任务上提升 dense captioning 和 procedural grounding，在判别式任务上提升 cross-modal retrieval。这里最值得注意的不是某一个 benchmark 的绝对值，而是收益具有任务一致性：如果数据只是语言重写得更好，通常只会改善 caption；如果时间对齐也更准，grounding 和 retrieval 也会一起受益。这个结果间接支持了作者关于“结构化重标注优于直接使用原始 ASR”的判断。消融层面，全文重点应当比较三类因素：是否做 shot segmentation、是否做 alignment filtering、是否加入 DeepSeek-R1 refinement。通常这三步分别对应局部上下文稳定性、坏样本剔除、全局语义/时间修正，少掉任何一步，数据质量都会明显下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 里对问题的界定，重点理解作者为什么不直接把 HowTo100M transcript 当 supervision。然后精读方法部分的 Figure 1 和 Sec. 3.2-3.4：一是视频切分和过滤标准，二是 Qwen2.5-VL 生成候选步骤的 prompt/输入组织方式，三是 DeepSeek-R1 如何做 refinement 和 merge。真正值得深挖的是“模型分工”而不是“用了哪个大模型”：如果换成别的 VLM/LLM，这条流水线是否仍成立，取决于局部 grounding 与全局整理是否被清楚拆开。实验部分优先看 DenseCaption100 的人工对齐评测，再看下游微调收益。若时间有限，抓住数据构建流程图、质量验证表、以及去掉 refinement/filtering 的消融即可，预计 20-30 分钟能把主线读清。若从预训练角度深入，建议额外思考两个问题：第一，自动重标注带来的收益，究竟来自文本规范化还是时间对齐改善；第二，这种 pipeline 能否迁移到语音、网页操作轨迹、GUI demonstration 等其他长序列多模态数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a data construction problem rather than a new video model: how to turn noisy in-the-wild instructional videos into temporally grounded, step-level supervision that is actually usable for long-horizon video-language training. Raw instructional corpora such as HowTo100M are attractive because they contain rich procedural demonstrations, but they are hard to use directly. ASR transcripts are noisy, colloquial, and full of ambiguous references. More importantly, narration and visual actions are often misaligned in time. If such data is consumed as-is, a model learns corrupted visual-language correspondences. The paper proposes a scalable, training-free pipeline that segments videos, filters poorly aligned content, generates candidate procedural steps, and then refines and merges them into a dense step annotation set.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is on the data side. For pretraining-oriented work, the paper is useful because it shows that large noisy multimodal corpora can be upgraded through structured relabeling rather than discarded or used raw. That is relevant not only to long-video VLMs, but also to any setting where supervision exists at scale but with weak temporal or semantic alignment. The contribution is not a new objective or architecture. The contribution is a practical recipe for converting weakly aligned multimodal traces into higher-quality supervision. The resulting DenseStep2M dataset contains roughly 100K instructional videos and 2M fine-grained procedural steps, and the paper shows that this relabeling pipeline improves downstream dense captioning, procedural grounding, and retrieval after fine-tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three stages. First, video filtering and segmentation. The system identifies instructional videos and splits each long video into visually coherent shots. This is not just a preprocessing convenience. It creates local contexts where a single action or sub-action is more likely to dominate, which makes later grounding more reliable. The pipeline also filters segments with poor visual-text alignment to avoid forcing the model to explain mismatched evidence. Second, candidate step generation. Qwen2.5-VL-72B is used to jointly inspect frames and transcripts and produce candidate procedural steps for each shot. The target is not generic captioning. It is structured procedural abstraction: converting noisy narration plus visual evidence into concise, instruction-like steps tied to temporal spans. Third, refinement and merging. DeepSeek-R1 is then used to clean up semantics, resolve vague references, improve temporal alignment, and merge fragmented steps across neighboring shots when they belong to the same action. This division of labor is the key design choice. The VLM handles local perception and grounding; the reasoning LLM handles long-context cleanup, rewriting, and global consistency. Compared with earlier pipelines that relied on a single model over transcripts or coarse visual cues, this design explicitly separates local multimodal evidence extraction from global temporal-semantic consolidation. The paper also introduces DenseCaption100, a human-annotated benchmark of 100 instructional videos, to validate annotation quality directly rather than relying only on downstream task gains.
summary_en.experiments: On the data side, the pipeline produces DenseStep2M with about 100K videos and 2M fine-grained procedural steps. On the validation side, the paper uses DenseCaption100 to compare automated annotations against human-written dense annotations. The abstract does not expose the full metric table, but the paper’s central claim is that the generated annotations align well with human standards in both semantics and temporal grounding. On the model side, fine-tuning VLMs on DenseStep2M improves both generative tasks, such as dense captioning and procedural grounding, and discriminative tasks, such as cross-modal retrieval. That pattern matters. If the pipeline only improved linguistic fluency, one would expect gains mostly on captioning. Gains on grounding and retrieval suggest that temporal alignment quality also improved. The most informative ablations are likely the ones removing shot segmentation, alignment filtering, or the DeepSeek-R1 refinement stage. These components correspond to local context stabilization, bad-sample removal, and global semantic-temporal correction, respectively, so they are the natural places to inspect where the quality gains actually come from.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and focus on the failure mode of using raw ASR supervision for long-horizon video learning. Then read the pipeline figure and the sections on segmentation, candidate generation, and refinement. The key question is not which frontier models were used, but why the pipeline is split into local multimodal grounding and global reasoning-based consolidation. That design choice is the main transferable idea. In the experiments, prioritize the DenseCaption100 quality evaluation before looking at downstream fine-tuning results. If reading time is limited, the pipeline overview, the annotation quality table, and the ablations on filtering/refinement are enough to capture the paper’s value in about 20 to 30 minutes. For a pretraining reader, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the gains come more from text normalization or from better temporal alignment, and whether the same relabeling recipe can be transferred to other long-sequence multimodal data such as speech, GUI trajectories, or web interaction traces.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和数据质检部分；它反映了长视频预训练数据从抓取转向模型辅助清洗的工程路线。
recommendation.en: Skim the pipeline and quality-control sections; it reflects the shift from raw long-video scraping to model-assisted curation for pretraining data.

paper.title: Beyond Screenshots: Evaluating VLMs' Understanding of UI Animations
paper.abstract: AI agents operating on user interfaces must understand how interfaces communicate state and feedback to act reliably. As a core communicative modality, animations are increasingly used in modern interfaces, serving critical functional purposes beyond mere aesthetics. Thus, understanding UI animation is essential for comprehensive interface interpretation. However, recent studies of Vision Language Models (VLMs) for UI understanding have focused primarily on static screenshots, leaving it unclear

summary.core_problem: 现有 UI 理解评测多依赖静态截图，无法回答 VLM 是否理解界面动画所表达的状态变化、反馈和交互含义。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向 UI 动画理解的小规模密集标注 benchmark。它补上了 GUI/VLM 评测中的动态界面维度，对多模态 Agent 的感知评测有价值，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 AniMINT，包含 300 个密集标注的 UI animation videos；评测 VLM 对动画效果感知、动画目的识别、动画含义解释等层级能力，区分低层运动检测和高层语义解释。
summary.experiments: 系统评测若干当前 VLM。摘要结论是模型能较可靠地检测 primitive motion，但高层动画解释不稳定；具体模型列表、评分协议和数值需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing UI-understanding evaluations focus on static screenshots, leaving unclear whether VLMs understand state changes, feedback, and interaction meaning conveyed through UI animations.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a small but densely annotated benchmark for UI animation understanding. It is useful for evaluating GUI-oriented multimodal agents, though it is not directly about base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce AniMINT, a dataset of 300 densely annotated UI animation videos. They evaluate VLMs on multiple levels: perceiving animation effects, identifying animation purposes, and interpreting animation meaning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates current VLMs. The abstract reports that models can reliably detect primitive motion but remain inconsistent on high-level animation interpretation; exact model lists and scores require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务定义和错误类型即可；它提醒 native multimodal 训练别只吃截图，但 300 条数据不足以支撑强结论。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and error taxonomy only; it reminds native multimodal training not to overfit screenshots, but 300 videos cannot support strong claims.

paper.title: DualFact+: A Multimodal Fact Verification Framework for Procedural Video Understanding
paper.abstract: We introduce DualFact, a dual-layer, multimodal factuality evaluation framework for procedural video captioning. DualFact separates factual correctness into conceptual facts, capturing abstract semantic roles (e.g., Action, Ingredient, Tool, Location), and contextual facts, capturing their grounded predicate-argument realizations in video. To support complete and role-consistent evaluation, DualFact incorporates implicit argument augmentation (VIA) and contrastive fact sets. We instantiate DualF

summary.core_problem: 评估程序性视频 caption 的事实一致性，尤其是模型是否漏掉关键动作、工具、食材、地点，以及这些角色是否和视频证据对齐。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态事实性评测框架，贡献主要在评测粒度和诊断能力：把事实错误拆成概念层事实和上下文层事实，能比常规 caption 指标更直接暴露 VLM 在程序性视频理解中的遗漏和角色混淆。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DualFact 双层框架：概念事实捕获抽象语义角色， contextual facts 捕获视频中实际落地的谓词-论元关系；引入 implicit argument augmentation 补全隐含论元，并构造 contrastive fact sets。框架有 DualFact-T 和 DualFact-V 两种模式，分别用文本证据和视频视觉证据做验证。
summary.experiments: 在 YouCook3-Fact 和 CraftBench-Fact 上评测。摘要没有给出模型参数量或具体提升数值，但报告称 DualFact 与人工事实性判断的相关性强于标准指标，尤其是在 contextual facts 上；同时发现现有多模态语言模型生成的 caption 流畅但常有事实不完整和角色级不一致。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, DFKI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets factuality evaluation for procedural video captioning, focusing on whether generated captions preserve key actions, ingredients, tools, locations, and their grounded role relations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation framework rather than a new foundation model. The useful part is the finer diagnostic split between conceptual and contextual facts, which makes omissions and role-level inconsistencies more visible than standard caption metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: DualFact separates factuality into conceptual facts over abstract semantic roles and contextual facts over grounded predicate-argument realizations. It adds implicit argument augmentation and contrastive fact sets, and instantiates two verification modes: DualFact-T against textual evidence and DualFact-V against video-grounded visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on YouCook3-Fact and CraftBench-Fact. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact numerical gains, but states that DualFact correlates better with human factuality judgments than standard metrics, especially for contextual facts, and diagnoses fluent but incomplete captions from current multimodal language models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, DFKI.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但做视频-文本对齐数据清洗时可借鉴事实分解；看框架定义和相关性实验即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the fact decomposition is useful for video-text data filtering; read the framework definition and correlation results only.

institutions: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)

paper.title: PushupBench: Your VLM is not good at counting pushups
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can recognize \textit{what} happens in video but fail to count \textit{how many} times. We introduce \textbf{PushupBench}, 446 long-form clips (avg. 36.7s) for evaluating repetition counting. The best frontier model achieves 42.1\% exact accuracy; open-source 4B models score $\sim$6\%, matching supervised baselines. We show that accuracy alone misleads -- weaker models exploit the modal count rather than reason temporally. Fine-tuning on counting with 1k sampl

summary.core_problem: 现有视频多模态大模型（VLM）的语义识别能力与细粒度时序推理能力存在显著差距，重复动作计数能力差，且现有重复计数基准多针对专用架构、视频时长偏短，无法有效评测通用VLM的时序推理能力。
summary.importance: 验证了动作重复计数不是窄域技能，而是通用时序推理能力的代理指标，为VLM预训练阶段的时序能力优化提供了低成本的评测与训练信号来源。
summary.technical_approach: 构建PushupBench基准，包含446条平均时长36.7s的健身视频片段，覆盖11个国家的不同创作者，标注细粒度动作周期。提出采用R²指标替代单一准确率，避免模型利用数据集统计规律作弊而非实际计数。
summary.experiments: 零-shot评测下，Gemini 3 Flash精确匹配准确率仅42.1%，开源4B参数Qwen3-VL准确率8.9%，专用监督模型TransRAC准确率6.73%。仅用391条计数样本微调Qwen3-VL，即可在MVBench、PerceptionTest、TVBench上分别获得2.45、1.23、2.75的性能提升，增益集中在时序推理类子任务，空间类任务性能无提升甚至下降。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1章引言的能力gap分析、第3章实验部分的跨基准迁移结果，附录的提示词模板与指标设计细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video vision-language models (VLMs) have a clear gap between semantic recognition and fine-grained temporal reasoning, with particularly poor performance on repetitive action counting. Existing repetition counting benchmarks are mostly designed for task-specific architectures with short video durations, which cannot effectively evaluate the temporal reasoning ability of general-purpose VLMs.
summary_en.importance: Repetitive action counting is verified as a proxy for general temporal reasoning rather than a narrow domain skill, providing a low-cost evaluation and training signal source for optimizing temporal capabilities during VLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The PushupBench benchmark is constructed with 446 fitness video clips of average 36.7s duration, covering creators from 11 countries with fine-grained action cycle annotations. The R² metric is introduced in addition to accuracy to avoid models exploiting dataset statistics instead of performing actual counting.
summary_en.experiments: Under zero-shot setting, Gemini 3 Flash achieves only 42.1% exact match accuracy, open-source 4B-parameter Qwen3-VL gets 8.9% accuracy, and dedicated supervised model TransRAC gets 6.73% accuracy. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL with only 391 counting samples brings 2.45, 1.23, 2.75 performance gains on MVBench, PerceptionTest and TVBench respectively. Gains concentrate on temporal reasoning subtasks, while spatial task performance stays flat or declines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the capability gap analysis in Section 1 Introduction, cross-benchmark transfer results in Section 3 Experiments, and prompt template + metric design details in the Appendix. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和实验表即可；小 benchmark 但信号干净，提醒视频预训练别只学事件标签，要测周期性时间绑定。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and result tables; small benchmark, but a clean signal that video pretraining should test periodic temporal binding, not just event labels.

paper.title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding

summary.core_problem: 视频多模态理解训练缺少大规模、跨任务一致标注数据；真实数据采集与标注成本高且覆盖不足。
summary.importance: 数据合成用于训练的工作：对MLLM/Video-LLM后训练数据工程有参考价值，但更偏应用型数据管线，方法论突破有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一的合成视频数据生成管线，可在单一框架内生成多任务格式监督（计数/QA/分割等）；并引入VQA式微调策略，用结构化问题驱动视觉对齐与推理，而非仅依赖caption/简单指令。
summary.experiments: 在三个视频理解任务上评测（摘要未给出任务名称、模型规模、合成数据规模、基线与提升幅度细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal video understanding needs large-scale, richly annotated, multi-task data, but real-world collection/annotation is expensive and limited in coverage.
summary_en.importance: A synthetic-data-for-training pipeline relevant to Video-MLLM post-training data engineering, though it appears more incremental than paradigm-shifting.
summary_en.technical_approach: An all-in-one synthetic video data generation pipeline supporting multiple supervision formats (counting/QA/segmentation, etc.), plus a VQA-style fine-tuning strategy using structured questions to encourage grounding and reasoning beyond captions/simple instructions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three challenging video understanding tasks, but the abstract omits model scale, synthetic data scale, baselines, and quantified gains.

recommendation.zh: 统一视频合成数据管线对落地有用，但研究新意不多；当作数据配方库，挑你关心的任务看生成模板与质量控制即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as an implementation-oriented synthetic video data pipeline, not much new research-wise; treat it as a cookbook—inspect the task templates and QC steps you’d reuse.

paper.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding
paper.abstract: We benchmark how internal reasoning traces, which we call thought streams, affect video scene understanding in vision-language models. Using four configurations of Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite across scenes extracted from 100 hours of video, we ask three questions: does more thinking lead to better outputs, where do the gains stop, and what do these models actually think about? We introduce three evaluation metrics. Contentfulness measures how much of the thought stream is useful sce

summary.core_problem: 评估内部推理轨迹（thought streams / CoT）在视觉语言模型处理视频场景理解任务中的实际收益和饱和点。
summary.importance: 定量分析了多模态模型在推理期计算（inference-time compute）的 scaling 行为，提出了衡量思考内容有效性和忠实度的新指标。
summary.technical_approach: 使用 Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 Flash Lite 在 100 小时视频场景上进行测试。引入 Contentfulness（有用内容占比）、Thought-Final Coverage（思考到输出的转化率）和 Dominant Entity Analysis 三个指标，并用 GPT-5 作为裁判。
summary.experiments: 发现增加思考带来的质量提升会迅速进入平台期，大部分收益集中在前几百个 token 内；Flash Lite 在质量和 token 消耗之间取得了最佳平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluates the actual benefits and saturation points of internal reasoning traces (thought streams / CoT) for video scene understanding in VLMs.
summary_en.importance: Quantitatively analyzes the scaling behavior of inference-time compute in multimodal models, introducing new metrics for thought utility and faithfulness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tests Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite on 100 hours of video scenes. Introduces metrics like Contentfulness, Thought-Final Coverage, and Dominant Entity Analysis, using GPT-5 as an independent judge.
summary_en.experiments: Finds that quality gains from additional thinking plateau quickly, with most improvements occurring in the first few hundred tokens; Flash Lite offers the best quality-to-token balance.

recommendation.zh: 对多模态 CoT 的定量分析，指出视频理解任务中 inference-time compute 的收益极易饱和，打破了 'think longer, do better' 的线性预期。
recommendation.en: Quantitative analysis of multimodal CoT showing that inference-time compute gains plateau very quickly in video understanding, challenging the 'think longer, do better' expectation.

paper.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding

summary.core_problem: 在视频场景理解的VLM中，显式“思考/推理痕迹”（thought streams）是否真的带来质量提升、提升在何处饱和、以及模型在思考中关注了什么。
summary.importance: 面向VLM推理过程的评测与分析工作：量化“更多思考token是否更好”及其边际收益，对推理预算、可解释性评测、以及推理时计算分配具有直接启发；属于有价值的VLM评测/机制分析交叉。
summary.technical_approach: 基于Gemini 2.5 Flash/Flash Lite多配置，提出三类指标：Contentfulness（思考内容有效性）、Thought-Final Coverage（思考到最终回答的一致性/覆盖）、Dominant Entity Analysis（关注实体/动作/场景的分布）；使用GPT-5作为独立裁判进行评估。
summary.experiments: 在约100小时视频抽取的场景上评测4种Gemini配置；主要发现为额外思考带来的质量增益很快饱和（多数提升在前几百token），Flash Lite在质量与token开销间更均衡；摘要未给出具体分数提升幅度与统计显著性细节。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper evaluates whether producing explicit intermediate “thought streams” improves video scene understanding in Gemini vision-language models, where the gains saturate, and what the models attend to during such reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: It provides an evaluation and analysis of reasoning-budget tradeoffs—quantifying whether more reasoning tokens actually help and with diminishing returns—informing interpretability assessments and compute allocation for multimodal video understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using multiple configurations of Gemini 2.5 Flash and Flash Lite, the authors define three analysis metrics: Contentfulness (usefulness of the thought content), Thought–Final Coverage (consistency/coverage between thoughts and final answers), and Dominant Entity Analysis (distribution of attended entities/actions/scenes); they use GPT-5 as an external judge to score and analyze outputs.
summary_en.experiments: On video-scene tasks derived from roughly 100 hours of video and across four Gemini configurations, the study finds that quality improvements from additional thought tokens saturate quickly (most gains within the first few hundred tokens) and that Flash Lite offers a better quality–token tradeoff; the abstract omits exact effect sizes and significance details.

recommendation.zh: 告诉你“多吐思考token”在视频VLM里收益何时饱和，适合做推理预算策略但与预训练关联弱；只看思考长度-性能曲线和失败案例分析。
recommendation.en: It quantifies when extra ‘thought stream’ tokens saturate for video VLMs—useful for inference-budget policy, less for pretraining; skim the length-vs-performance curves and the failure analyses.

paper.title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos

summary.core_problem: 现有视频多模态模型缺乏对“室内视频中小物体的精确定位与可用空间表达”的直接评测，导致模型空间理解能力难以被诊断与推动。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为Benchmark/数据集：首次面向室内视频小物体中心的空间理解提出PinpointQA，覆盖从存在性判断到结构化空间预测的递进任务，有助于诊断VLM在细粒度空间指代、参照物选择与可执行位置表达上的短板。
summary.technical_approach: 基于ScanNet++与ScanNet200构建数据集，通过中间空间表示生成QA，设计四类任务：TPV（目标存在验证）、NRI（最近参照物识别）、FSD（细粒度空间描述）、SSP（结构化空间预测），强调“可用于下游”的精确位置表达而非泛化描述。
summary.experiments: 数据规模：1,024个场景、10,094个QA；任务覆盖四种难度递进设置；摘要未提供具体参评模型、baseline清单与SOTA/提升幅度细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Current video-language benchmarks insufficiently test precise localization and actionable spatial expression for small objects in indoor videos, limiting diagnosis and progress on fine-grained spatial understanding.
summary_en.importance: PinpointQA provides a dedicated dataset/benchmark centered on small-object spatial reasoning in indoor videos, with progressively harder tasks that expose weaknesses in fine-grained reference, landmark selection, and executable location descriptions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200, the dataset generates QA via intermediate spatial representations and defines four tasks: target presence verification (TPV), nearest reference identification (NRI), fine-grained spatial description (FSD), and structured spatial prediction (SSP), emphasizing precise, downstream-usable spatial outputs rather than generic descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: PinpointQA includes 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs spanning four difficulty levels/tasks; the abstract does not list evaluated models, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 知道有这个小物体空间诊断集就够了：只看任务分层与评测指标，能快速补你内部eval里“可执行定位表达”的空白。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a small-object spatial diagnostic: just read the task ladder + metrics to patch the “actionable localization language” hole in your internal evals.
